author: Flo (@flohoeller)

app_icon_hops.rotation_scale: No meaningful rotation or scaling observed; position-only reconstruction.
app_icon_hops.first_version_omission: App logos were static, omitting the two hop waves.

classification.colors_geometry: Measured from decoded reference frames, approximate due to compression.
classification.timing: Visual estimate from video sampled at 10 fps.
classification.easing: Card translation interpolates measured 60fps frame positions. Icon hops use a measured smoothstep fit. Shimmer uses triangular grayscale profiles fitted to video text masks.
classification.font: Inter Regular used as a visual approximation with measured horizontal adjustments.
classification.cursor: Reference cursor omitted from delivered clean preview.
classification.hop_timing: Derived from colored-pixel centroid tracking across decoded 60 fps reference frames; smoothstep model fitted to observed trajectory.

author_source.availability: Official README states Chat Composer is part of affectUI Pro and source is excluded from the MIT repository. No author component code included.
